name: Brand & Product Foundation
description: The keystone setup package for a new brand instance. Runs a deep, guided intake interview (brand, full product catalog, claims, naming, connections, KPI/attribution, delivery) and writes a canonical brand-product profile that every other Runneth package reads instead of re-asking. Workspace-agnostic and self-onboarding: resolves the workspace from Motion context, asks one question at a time, and writes nothing until the person confirms. Install stages files only.
